summary: One changed Scaladoc violates the required return-documentation convention.

items.issue: The summary begins with “Produces” but the comment has no `@return` tag. Under the stated convention, omitting `@return` is only allowed when the description begins with “Returns”.
items.suggestion: Either change the summary to “Returns a new array …” or add `@return a new array whose element type is `runtimeClass``.
